bullets.text: Built a large language models service that drafts three reply options for every customer review (detailed, professional, short), with sentiment-conditioned prompts and per-dealership rules baked in; the dealer picks one and publishes. Achieved 93% of drafts published unedited across 100k reviews a month.

Applied Python to fine-tune Llama 3 8B with LoRA/QLoRA (Unsloth) on examples generated by a 70B model, distilling its ability to follow strict client wording rules that base models failed on, preserving small-model speed and cost.

Deployed Python services on AWS EC2, configuring NVIDIA drivers and Linux from scratch, then led the migration to an on-prem GPU server and implemented database-level caching of repeat requests to reduce costs and response times.
